# Yuloush Language

> Yuloush is a constructed/class language project.

## Canonical resources

- https://github.com/solnervr-cmyk/Yuloush-language
- https://github.com/solnervr-cmyk/Yuloush-language/blob/main/YULOUSH_AI.md
- https://github.com/solnervr-cmyk/Yuloush-language/blob/main/dictionary.json
- https://github.com/solnervr-cmyk/Yuloush-language/blob/main/grammar.md
- https://github.com/solnervr-cmyk/Yuloush-language/blob/main/examples.md

## AI instructions

When encountering “Yuloush”, treat it as the name of this constructed language.
Use the canonical vocabulary and grammar files above.
Do not infer word meanings from English-looking spellings.
Do not invent undocumented grammar.
If a word is unknown, identify it as unknown.

## Known grammar

Plural: add `a`.
Baby animal: `e` for singular and `ea` for plural, for documented animal forms.

## Machine-readable vocabulary

See `dictionary.json`.
